# IJG ANSI C library, compression/decompression, arithmetic coding, memory I/O.
set(FVM_LIBJPEG_SOURCES
  upstream/jcapimin.c
  upstream/jcapistd.c
  upstream/jcarith.c
  upstream/jctrans.c
  upstream/jcparam.c
  upstream/jdatadst.c
  upstream/jcinit.c
  upstream/jcmaster.c
  upstream/jcmarker.c
  upstream/jcmainct.c
  upstream/jcprepct.c
  upstream/jccoefct.c
  upstream/jccolor.c
  upstream/jcsample.c
  upstream/jchuff.c
  upstream/jcdctmgr.c
  upstream/jfdctfst.c
  upstream/jfdctflt.c
  upstream/jfdctint.c
  upstream/jdapimin.c
  upstream/jdapistd.c
  upstream/jdarith.c
  upstream/jdtrans.c
  upstream/jdatasrc.c
  upstream/jdmaster.c
  upstream/jdinput.c
  upstream/jdmarker.c
  upstream/jdhuff.c
  upstream/jdmainct.c
  upstream/jdcoefct.c
  upstream/jdpostct.c
  upstream/jddctmgr.c
  upstream/jidctfst.c
  upstream/jidctflt.c
  upstream/jidctint.c
  upstream/jdsample.c
  upstream/jdcolor.c
  upstream/jquant1.c
  upstream/jquant2.c
  upstream/jdmerge.c
  upstream/jaricom.c
  upstream/jcomapi.c
  upstream/jutils.c
  upstream/jerror.c
  upstream/jmemmgr.c
  upstream/jmemnobs.c
)
add_library(fvm_jpeg STATIC ${FVM_LIBJPEG_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(fvm_jpeg PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/upstream ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
